caption: Global Recognition Awards presents The Exceptional Achievement Award to Kay Pickett for her work with The Jackson Crossing Mall! "Pickett received the highest possible score in the Leadership category, reflecting her ability to inspire those around her and make principled decisions under real-world constraints. Her participation in the Jackson County Chamber of Commerce Leadership Jackson program signals a deliberate investment in her own professional growth, one that feeds directly back into the community she serves. Rather than treating her position as purely operational, she has approached it as a platform for civic engagement, building trust with local institutions and positioning the mall as a resource rather than merely a retail destination. Pickett's service scores were equally decisive. Evaluators assessed her across three dimensions: community impact, innovative approaches to societal needs, and measurable service outcomes, and she received a perfect score of five in each. Global Recognition Awards employs the Rasch model to create a linear measurement scale that enables precise comparisons across applicants who excel in different areas; Pickett's uniformly high scores across all service indicators placed her at the top of that scale without ambiguity. The data confirmed what the narrative evidence already suggested: her contributions carry real weight in the community she serves. Global Recognition Awards continues to identify individuals whose work raises the standard within their field, and Kayli Pickett's contributions to Jackson County's civic and commercial life make her a fitting recipient of this recognition." #theglobalrecognitionawards

Global Recognition Awards-Exceptional Achievement! "Kayli Pickett has been recognized with a 2026 Global Recognition Award for her sustained commitment to transforming The Jackson Crossing Mall into a genuine community anchor through exemplary leadership, measurable service outcomes, and creative media work that collectively reflect excellence in Customer Experience, Leadership, Service, and Artistic Accomplishment. Pickett serves as Media, Marketing, and Events Director at The Jackson Crossing Mall in Jackson County, where she has become a driving force behind the mall's remarkable recovery at a time when retail spaces across the United States continue to struggle with declining foot traffic and rising vacancies. Her work stands as a clear example of what focused, community-centered leadership can achieve when applied with consistency and purpose." Creativity is not a secondary function in Pickett's role. It is central to how she communicates the mall's identity and purpose. Through graphic design, photography, and targeted media campaigns, she documents and amplifies the stories of local businesses and nonprofit partnerships. This artistic dimension of her work does more than generate content; it shapes how the community perceives the mall and, by extension, how invested residents feel in its success. The visual and narrative outputs she produces serve a marketing function and a civic one, reinforcing the mall's standing as a place where people and organizations belong. "Alex Sterling, a spokesperson for Global Recognition Awards, acknowledged the significance of Pickett's recognition: "Kayli Pickett exemplifies the kind of leadership and service commitment that this award was designed to honor. Her ability to connect creative vision with genuine community impact, and to produce measurable results in a challenging industry environment, is precisely what separates exceptional contributors from the rest." Global Recognition Awards continues to identify individuals whose work raises the standard within their field, and Kayli Pickett's contributions to Jackson County's civic and commercial life make her a fitting recipient of this recognition. We are so proud to celebrate this amazing achievement and the impact Kay continues to make in our community! #theglobalrecognitionawards

caption: Waking up to the news of the fires here in Jackson has my heart aching for our residents. In moments like this, the last thing anyone has the capacity for is digging through the internet trying to find help. I took some time this morning to compile a list of local resources to help get anyone affected started. Whether you are a family who has been displaced, a mother in need of essentials, someone looking for clothing or food, or a pet owner trying to care for your animals, I’ve tried to include resources that cover a wide range of needs. If you are a local organization, business, or individual who can provide support — whether that’s supplies, shelter, services, or donations — please reach out to Whimsy through my personal email: 📧 Itskaypickett@gmail.com I want to make sure your information can be shared quickly and prioritized so those in need can find help as fast as possible. To those affected: you are seen. Our community is rallying around you. Wishing you peace, rest, warm hugs, and a moment to breathe during an incredibly difficult time. 🤍 — Kay / Whimsy
